map.依据 Arrhenius 方程对油品氧化反应速率的工程近似（温度每升 10℃ 速: Based on the Arrhenius equation for oil oxidation reaction rate engineering approximation (rate roughly doubles per 10 C rise), combined with oil type, operating temperature and speed, estimate the low oil mist life.

map.算法：基准寿命按油品取（矿物油 2000h、合成油 PAO 4000h、酯类油: Algorithm: base life by oil type (mineral oil 2000 h, synthetic PAO 4000 h, ester oil 6000 h, silicone oil 5000 h); temperature factor = 0.5 to the power of ((temperature minus 60) / 10), below 60 C is 1 + (60 minus temperature) / 100; speed factor at or below 3000 rpm is 1 + 0.1 times (1 minus speed / 3000), above 3000 rpm is max(0.1, 0.85 to the power of ((speed minus 3000) / 1000)); low oil mist design factor fixed 1.3; lubrication life = base times temperature factor times speed factor times 1.3; days = life / 24; recommended oil change interval = max(500, round(life times 0.8)); oil mist generation = speed times temperature / 100000 times 0.5 (mg/h).
map.例：矿物油、70℃、3000rpm → 温度因子 0.5、转速因子 1、寿命 1: Example: mineral oil, 70 C, 3000 rpm gives temperature factor 0.5, speed factor 1, life 1300 h (54.2 days), oil change interval 1040 h, oil mist generation 1.05 mg/h, evaluated as normal condition, low oil mist design works well. Switch to synthetic oil (PAO, base 4000 h), 90 C, 6000 rpm gives temperature factor 0.125, speed factor 0.6141, life 399.2 h (16.6 days), oil change interval at lower limit 500 h, oil mist 2.7 mg/h, prompts high temperature, monitor oil mist concentration.
map.温度每升高 10℃ 寿命减半的依据？: What is the basis for halving life every 10 C rise?
map.是按 Arrhenius 方程对氧化反应速率的常用工程近似：温度每升 10℃，油: It is a common engineering approximation of the oxidation reaction rate by the Arrhenius equation: every 10 C rise, oil oxidation rate roughly doubles and life halves. Synthetic oil has better oxidation resistance, and the actual decay is slower than this rule.
map.低油雾因子 1.3 是什么意思？: What does the low oil mist factor 1.3 mean?
map.表示采用低油雾配方（高黏度指数基础油 + 抗雾添加剂）相比普通配方可延长约 30: It means using a low oil mist formulation (high viscosity index base oil plus anti-mist additive) can extend life by about 30% compared with ordinary formulation; it is a uniform correction of the tool, and the actual improvement should be adjusted by the oil measured data.
